display_plain_text.description: If true, outputs plain text instead of using the ncurses interface.

loop_interval.description: Delay in seconds between updates when in loop mode.

show_battery.description: Enable display of battery status information.

show_ac.description: Enable display of AC adapter status information.

show_fan.description: Enable display of fan speed/temperature information.

show_thermal.description: Enable display of thermal zone temperature information.

show_cpu_freq.description: Enable display of current CPU frequency.

show_governor.description: Enable display of the current CPU scaling governor.

show_not_found.description: Display ACPI data that is typically hidden or marked as not found.
